query:
SELECT id AS "id!", at AS "at!" FROM (
               SELECT id, expires_on::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $1 + make_interval(mins => $2::int) AS at
               FROM documents
               WHERE workspace_id = app_workspace_id() AND deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_on IS NOT NULL
           ) t
           WHERE at > $3 AND at <= $4
           ORDER BY at, id
           LIMIT $5
